description: Electric Vehicle Charging Stations is a dataset listed in State of Connecticut open data portal (data.ct.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Connecticut. Existing public Electric Vehicle (EV) charging stations within Connecticut from US DOE map found at complemented with research done by DEEP as of 05/27/2020. Coverage: Connecticut. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are ct, ev, charging stations. The table has 13 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Energy and Environmental Protection. The portal shows 2020-05-20 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ct-gov-portal.
